title: Covariance-normal-ordered full three-component Class-II energy composite
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 full-production q^-4 Gaussian on the fixed three-torus, three complex components in the six-real convention, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, positive production Q_II, embedded Pauli generators, exact/dealiased products, and the declared common real-even bounded scalar spectral regulator class, subtracting each regulator's exact conditional derivative-pair contraction jointly defines J_A,i^2, J_A,i*K_A,i, K_A,i^2 and the complete Class-II energy density. For every kappa>0 the renormalised densities converge to one regulator-independent limit in L2(Omega; H^(-1-kappa)), and their spatial integrals converge in L2 with mean zero.
scope: CLOSED@FIXED-FLOOR-COVARIANCE-NORMAL-ENERGY-COMPOSITE on L=16 for the A1 production covariance, three complex components, six-real normalization, fixed positive rho floor, common real-even uniformly bounded scalar multipliers converging pointwise to one with compact support or a uniform Schwartz tail, each regulator's exact derivative covariance subtraction, and exact Fourier convolution or sufficient de-aliasing. H^-1, the interacting exponential weight, the full-field bare law, and floor removal are outside scope.
falsifier: A wrong complex/six-real factor; a nonzero common-even value-derivative contraction; a missing Q^2, QPR, or P^2R^2 Gaussian-IBP connection; failure of the Bessel-weighted H^(-1-kappa) Cauchy bound or exact-covariance scheme limit; a failed direct current/matrix identity, conditional Gaussian mean, N^-1 Hilbert-Schmidt tail, authority hash, frozen determinant bound, sharp mass-threshold identity, or plane-wave null control; or any failed primary, independent, or integrated assertion falsifies the pinned closure.

reproduction.expected: PASS: primary (29/29); PASS: independent (17/17); ASSERTS: 74/74; A7-CLASSII-RENORMALISED-ENERGY-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

no_overclaim: This claim does not prove a uniform Nelson or Boue-Dupuis negative-exponential estimate, interacting-density L1 convergence, a full three-component constructive Gibbs measure, full-field bare concentration, rho-floor removal, arbitrary asymmetric-regulator universality, infinite volume, phase transition, BCC existence or selection, T6, or T7.

notes: T5 PINNED-CLOSURE@FIXED-FLOOR-COVARIANCE-NORMAL-ENERGY-COMPOSITE. The exact six-real conditional contraction removes the divergent local derivative pair in the Gaussian composite.
